Metadata.Goal: Make C# existential-rule governance observably match Bun.
Metadata.Description: Validate definitions, resolve aliases dynamically, and fail safely without initialized storage.

TaskSpace.name: sync-dotnet-om-existential-governance-parity
TaskSpace.Description: Close existential definition and runtime governance gaps.

TaskGroup.name: Characterize and implement
TaskGroup.Description: Implement the three parity behaviors with paired C# evidence.

Task.name: Implement definition validation and runtime alias resolution
Task.Description: Reject invalid where predicates and canonicalize each loaded rule at execution.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Invalid definitions persist nothing and renamed aliases still execute.

Task.name: Make no-init queries safe
Task.Description: List, check, and apply treat absent rule storage as empty.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: No-init queries return empty safe results.

Task.name: Expand runtime queries across historical alias storage
Task.Description: Resolve canonical names and query all historical type, relation and attribute aliases that map to them at existential runtime.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Pre-rename alias-stored entities, edges and properties satisfy post-rename existential rules.
Canonical current storage remains deterministic and no-init behavior is unchanged.

TaskGroup.name: Verification
TaskGroup.Description: Run paired existential and full suites.

Task.name: Verify behavior parity
Task.Description: Verify Bun and C# cases and close gaps.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Both runtimes pass existential governance matrices.

Task.name: Reverify historical alias-storage correction
Task.Description: Run the corrected paired suites and full C# OM harness after the second gap-loop finding.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Historical alias-stored entities, edges, properties, and no-init paths have current cross-runtime evidence.
The full C# OM harness remains green after the correction.
